purpose: Verifier-owned fixture manifest contract for the independent acceptance driver; contains identifiers, never credentials.
credentials_source: NOTIFICATION_ACCEPTANCE_LOGIN_EMAIL and NOTIFICATION_ACCEPTANCE_LOGIN_PASSWORD environment variables; never this file or driver arguments
reset_rule: Reset each criterion to its named fixture state before observations. The reset adapter is test-only and must not alter production code or bypass normal Account/Login.
time_rule: Driver creates relative past/current/future values from server-observed Asia/Taipei time and records minute-normalized observations.
